div.div: Known limit: the Wi-Fi relay sustains about 0.28 MB/s to the host and can drop live-event frames under stalls. Drops are reported as EVT_OVERRUN(stage=2); control frames are never dropped. The ESP32-S3 USB transport port is the planned replacement (P9.1).

text.tspan: Known limit: the Wi-Fi relay sustains about 0.28 MB/s to the host and can drop live-event frames under stalls. Drops are reported as EVT_OVERRUN(stage=2); control frames are
never dropped. The ESP32-S3 USB transport port is the planned replacement (P9.1).
